dog.description_text: Meet Norton , a social gent who embodies the saying "you are only as old as you feel." At about 8 years old this super friendly, spunky, yet mature boy is ready to enjoy all the happy moments the world has to offer. Norton has recently joined us here at Every Last One rescue and everyday we wake up excited to learn more about him. Check back often for updates - he's already showing us how soulfully special he is.
dog.name: Norton
